title: Bitcoin Price Trades Near $64,000 as Fed’s Waller Floats Half-Point Hike
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Trades Near $64,000 as Fed’s Waller Floats Half-Point Hike Bitcoin price traded near $64,000 Wednesday morning as Fed Governor Christopher Waller floated a half-point December rate hike, offsetting a lift from Nvidia earnings. This post Bitcoin Price Trades Near $64,000 as Fed’s Waller Floats Half-Point Hike first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
